dedupe_keys.name: experimental dataset on the free rocking response of masonry blocks

description: This release records 135 free-vibration tests across twelve limestone-block slenderness ratios, including nominally identical specimens. Four-camera image correlation provides raw and processed motion, angular velocity and energy-related quantities. Several definitions of restitution describe impact dissipation, supporting assessment of variability and rocking models for built cultural heritage. The dataset is provided by Structural Laboratory of the Civil Engineering Department of the University of Minho through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2022. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED labels the resource CC BY 4.0, while DOI or repository metadata states CC-BY-NC-4.0. Applicable licence terms remain unresolved. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
